1
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday,  the November 22, 2006/Agrahayana 1, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs; Labour and
Employment; Rural Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 20
Dumping of electronic waste
†*1. SHRI MAHENDRA SAHNI: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the developed
countries are turning India into a dumping
ground for electronic waste due to
paradoxical situation prevailing in the EXIM
Policy;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government have
formulated a policy for bringing uniformity
in paradoxical laws; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Impact of tax structure on the
industries
*2. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether any survey has been done
to assess the impact of tax structure during
the recent past on the industries;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is a fact that majority
industries disfavour the current taxation
system for its complicated nature; and
(d) the steps taken by Government to
redress the grievances of industries?
Increase in the number of malls
†*3. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER SINGH
MAJITHA:
SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the number
of malls which were only 30 in 2003 in
megapolise in the country are reported to
be 220 by 2007;
(b) if not, the facts thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the annual
growth rate of retail market in the country
is estimated to be 30 per cent;
(d) if not, the facts thereof; and
(e) the average estimated annual share
of retail market sector in the Gross Domestic
Product of the country?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi

2
Fragging in the Army
*4. SHRIMATI SYEDA ANWARA
TAIMUR:
SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that recently there
have been a number of incidents of fragging
in the Army, inasmuch as eight seniors,
including a Major, are reported to have been
shot dead by troops under their command in
J&K since September, 2006;
(b) if so, the details of these incidents
and the reasons underlying such killings; and
(c) the steps taken to review the needs
and demands of the force, especially the
personnel deployed in the counter-insurgency
operations in J&K and other sensitive
regions?
Mental pressure on personnel of
para-military forces
*5. SHRI RAMDAS AGARWAL: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the para-
military forces at present are being deployed
by Government in Kashmir so often that they
are feeling very heavy mental pressure
resulting in their committing suicide and even
killing their senior officers/colleagues;
(b) if so, what are the reasons therefor;
(c) what are the details of the para-
military forces deployed by Government till
date, number-wise, place-wise at various
border points during the last three years; and
(d) the remedial steps Government
propose to take to reduce this mental
pressure being faced by our para-military
personnel?
Transfer of land for developing SEZs
*6. SHRI O.T. LEPCHA:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the land
acquired by certain State Governments has
been transferred to the private players to
develop SEZs; if so, the details thereof;
(b) if so, on what basis, the
compensation was calculated for the
acquired land;
(c) what steps have been taken to
rehabilitate the affected farmers;
(d) whether liability towards
compensation and rehabilitation is shared
amongst developer of SEZs, State
Government and the Central Government;
(e) whether Government have
formulated guidelines for the State
Governments for acquiring the land for
SEZs; if so, the details thereof; and
(f) if not, the reasons therefor?
FTAs with different countries
*7. SHRI S.S. AHLUWALIA: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) broad characteristics of Free Trade
Agreements (FTA) entered into with
different countries;
(b) year-wise details of countries with
whom FTAs have been signed since the
last five years till 31st October, 2006
indicating special reciprocal features, if
existed in FTA with any country(ies);
(c) whether Government are
contemplating to enter into FTA with other
countries;
(d) if so, details thereof and proposed
time-frame for the same;

3
(e) the annual export-import trade
volume between India and each FTA partner
country and also potential FTA partner
countries, year-wise since 2003-04;
and
(f) the additional benefits, if any, that
would accrue under FTA to our domestic
economy?
Rural unemployed registered under
NREGS
*8. SHRI M.V. MYSURA REDDY:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the State-wise and category-wise
details of rural unemployed people registered
for jobs under the National Rural
Employment Guarantee Scheme during the
last one year;
(b) the State-wise details of such
unemployed people provided employment
under the above scheme during this period;
(c) the State-wise details of amount spent
by Government and State Governments on
providing employment under the scheme
during this period;
(d) whether any target in this regard has
been fixed by Government during the year
2006-07 for providing employment to the
poor people; and
(e) if so, the State-wise details thereof?
Cases of rape and harassment of
women
†*9. DR. PRABHA THAKUR:
SHRI JAI PARKASH
AGGARWAL:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state  the State-wise and year-
wise details of cases of rape and harassment
of women during last three years?
Kudumbashree project in Kerala
*10. SHRI B.J. PANDA: Will the
Minister of RURAL DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that
Kudumbashree project in Kerala has played
a magnificent role in poverty alleviation;
(b)  how far this project has empowered
the BPL families; and
(c) what is the action plan of the Centre
to encourage such projects in other
backward regions of the country to improve
the economy of poor strata of society?
Scheme to keep child labourers away
from hazardous industries
*11. SHRI N.R. GOVINDARAJAR:
Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
formulate a new scheme to keep the child
labourers away from hazardous industries
in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government have received
any financial assistance from international
organizations in this regard;
(d) if so, the details thereof and the total
amount of foreign assistance received and
spent in this regard; and
(e) the number of child labourers
benefited from the assistance?
Districts covered under Disaster Risk
Management Programme
*12. SHRIMATI VIPLOVE
THAKUR: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) the districts, State-wise, covered
under $ 20 million United Nation
Development Programme (UNDP)
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi

4
sponsored Disaster Risk Management
Programme (DRMP), in the country;
(b) whether despite the fact that spate
of flash floods, cloudbursts, avalanches and
landslides wreak havoc, damaging life and
property worth crores of rupees in the State
of Himachal Pradesh every year, not even
a single district in the State has been covered
under DRMP;
(c) if so, the  reasons therefor;
(d) whether Government propose to
bring the most vulnerable districts of the
State under this scheme; and
(e) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Scheme for rural homeless poor
people in Assam
*13. SHRI DWIJENDRA NATH
SHARMAH: Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have launched
any new scheme for the rural homeless poor
people in the country particularly in the
State of Assam;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the above scheme is being
implemented in the country;
(d) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor; and
(e) the steps taken by Government for
allocation and release of more funds for the
above purpose in Assam?
Approved SEZs
†*14.DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER SINGH
MAJITHA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that  several zones
have been approved under the Special
Economic Zones scheme in the country;
(b) if so, the number of zones approved
so far till the end of October, 2006;
(c) the number of these zones in each
State; and
(d) the extent  of land required for setting
up of these zones in each State?
Limiting concessions to ASEAN by
restructuring negotiations list
*15. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India has
conveyed to Association of South-East
Asian Nations (ASEAN) that it would  not
grant more concessions and that negotiation
list would not cut below 800 items in Indo-
ASEAN FTA;
(b) if so, details thereof  and the reasons
therefor; and
(c) its impact on the member countries?
Declining employment opportunities
†*16.MS. SUSHILA TIRIYA:
SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the number of persons provided with
employment during the last two years;
(b) whether it is a fact that organized as
well as unorganized sectors have registered
decline in employment during the last five
years;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the specific measures being taken by
Government in order to provide more
employment opportunities?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi

5
NEW DELHI; YOGENDRA NARAIN,
The 16th November, 2006 Secretary-General.
Kartika 25, 1928 (Saka)
Need to use wasteland for setting up
SEZs
*17. SHRIMATI N. P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that farmland is
diverted for setting up of SEZs in the country;
(b) if so, does it not hamper the agriculture
production in the country;
(c) whether there is any proposal before
the Ministry for making it mandatory, by
amending the Land Acquisition Act, if
necessary, that SEZs should be developed
only on wasteland and not on agriculture
land;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) whether Government propose to
formulate a regulatory mechanism to
oversee the acquisition of land for SEZs in
various States?
Increase in ratio of unemployed youth
*18. SHRI TARIQ ANWAR: Will the
Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the ratio of
unemployed youth is increasing day by day;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the names of the schemes which are
providing employment to the youths;
(d) how many jobs are provided under
each scheme, State-wise, specially in Bihar
and Maharashtra; and
(e) the steps being taken in this regard?
Enactment of new Police Act
*19. DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Central Government propose
to enact a new Police Act and repeal the
1861 Act on the lines of Soli Sorabjee
Committee draft report;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the main recommendations or salient
features of the Soli Sorabjee Committee
report; and
(d) the reaction of the Central
Government in this regard?
Construction of  roads under PMGSY
in H.P.
†*20. SHRI BHAGWATI SINGH: Will
the Minister of RURAL DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) the amount sanctioned by
Government to Himachal Pradesh for
construction of roads under Pradhan Mantri
Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY) during the
last three years;
(b) the names of such roads and the
details of the amount made available for
these roads;
(c) by when the construction work of
Nandala-Madhara and Jaungla-Anboi-
Gumna  roads located in Chhawara section
of Shimla district  would be completed under
the scheme; and
(d) whether these roads would be fully
metalled?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi

1
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday,  the November 22, 2006/Agrahayana 1, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs; Labour and
Employment; Rural Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 100
Adverse impact of import of cheap
palm oil and vegetable oil
†1. SHRI PYARELAL KHANDEL-
WAL: Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that more than 50
per cent of mills and vegetable oil industries
in the  country are facing closure due to
import of cheap palm oil and duty free
import of vegetable oil from Nepal;
(b) whether it is a fact that the remaining
functional mills are on the verge of closure;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the action Government are going to
take to get rid of such a situation?
Export of pharmaceutical and
chemical items
2. SHRI DWIJENDRA NATH
SHARMAH: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of pharmaceutical and
chemical items being exported to the
various countries;
(b) the value of export made to these
countries during the last three years; and
(c) what steps are being taken by
Government to increase the exports and to
earn huge foreign exchange?
Package for development of cash crops
sector in Kerala
3. SHRI K. CHANDRAN PILLAI: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government received any
proposal for a special package for the
development of cash crops sector from the
Government of Kerala;
(b) if so, details of the proposal therein
and the action taken by the Government;
and
(c) details thereof?
Employment to farmers in SEZs
†4. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the number of Special Economic
Zones established in different States under
SEZ rules so far;
(b) the number of people likely to get
employment in such zones;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

2
(c) the number of Special Economic
Zones likely to be established during the
next five years; and
(d) whether provision have been made
to provide employment to the farmers
whose lands have been acquired for the
establishment of Special Economic
Zones?
Pending SEZ proposals
†5. SHRI MANGANI LAL
MANDAL: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) the current status of Special
Economic Zones (SEZ) in the country;
(b) the number of such Special Economic
Zones whose proposals have been
approved, so far;
(c) the number of remaining proposals
pending for approval, at present; and
(d) the State-wise status and details
thereof?
Appraisal of implementation of WTO
agreements
6. SHRI C. RAMACHANDRAIAH:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has made
appraisal of the benefits accrued to and the
losses suffered by the country after the
implementation of the WTO agreements a
decade ago; and
(b) the details of increased imports in
the country in the context of accumulation
of vast amounts of foreign exchange and
increase in exports during the same period?
EOUs in Andhra Pradesh
7. SHRI C. RAMACHANDRAIAH:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether cent per cent export
oriented industries have been set up in
Andhra Pradesh by Government;
(b) if so, the details thereof during the
last two years;
(c) the names of the industries/firms set
up or approved to be set up; and
(d) the details of the facilities provided
to cent per cent export oriented
industries?
Pressure exerted by developed
countries on agricultural issues
8. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether developed countries and
others have been pressing India to offer
concession in regard to agricultural issues
before reviving trade talks under the aegis
of the World Trade Organization; and
(b) if so, Government’s reaction
thereto?
Indo-China Eminent Persons Group
meeting
9. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there was a
meeting of the India-China Eminent Persons
Group in the last week of September, 2006,
to discuss trade and other economic
issues;
(b) if so, the details of the
meeting;
(c) whether it is a fact that China
registered its concern before Government
over blacklisting some of its companies;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

3
(d) if so, the details of companies that
have been blacklisted and the reasons behind
blacklisting; and
(e) whether this move will have any
impact on the bilateral trade turnover
of US$ 18 billion between India and
China?
Safeguards in patent laws
10. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the drug companies have
requested Government to ensure that
crucial safeguards are introduced while
amending the existing patent laws; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and the action
taken thereon?
Stagnating Indo-Russian trade
11. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the reasons for stagnation of Indo-
Russian trade at US$ 2 billions for more
than a decade;
(b) whether any trade working groups
consisting of both the countries have been
constituted to increase bilateral trade;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) whether it is also a fact that recently
a women business delegation of India
visited Russia to increase trade between
the two countries;
(e) if so, the details thereof;
(f) whether there are any plans to open
a chain of stores of Indian goods which
was in operation during Soviet Union under
the name 'Ganga'; and
(g) if so, details thereof?
Adverse effect of FTAs on Virginia
tobacco growers
12. SHRI V. HANUMANTHA RAO:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
Andhra Pradesh Virginia tobacco growers
are being adversely affected due to Free
Trade Agreements with some countries;
(b) whether Government are holding
any discussion in this regard;
(c) what steps will be taken to exempt
such products from Free Trade Agreements
which will negatively impact Andhra
farmers; and
(d) what steps will be taken to review
all such Free Trade Agreements which
negatively affect farmers?
Promotion of trade and export
†13. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are planning
to spend money for promotion of trade
and export in foreign countries during the
years 2005-06 and 2006-07; and
(b) the details of industries of Madhya
Pradesh selected for this purpose?
Tea package for development of tea
industry
†14. SHRI SAMAN PATHAK: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether a tea package has been
drawn up for development of tea industry
by Government;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

4
(c) whether Government are
contemplating on constituting any
monitoring committee to keep monitoring
the same; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Objections raised about use of land
for SEZs
15. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that objections
have been raised against acquisition of land
for growing number of SEZs;
(b) if so, details of the grounds of
objections;
(c) the details of the SEZs approved so
far and those under consideration and total
areas to be developed under SEZs; and
(d) the target dates fixed for completion
of work on approved SEZs?
Sale of products by foreign companies
in retail market
†16. SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH  MAJITHA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have allowed foreign companies to set up
their independent sale outlet to sell their
products in the retail market of the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) when the permission was given and
names of the foreign companies that have
started functioning since permission was
granted; and
(d) names of the brands being sold by
them and the benefits Indian consumers
will stand to gain therefrom?
Increase in share of manufacturing in
GDP
17. SHRIMATI S.G. INDIRA: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
had decided to increase the share of
manufacturing in the country's Gross
Domestic Product from 17 to 33 per cent;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is a fact that Government
had constituted a sub-committee to
recommend a strategy for growth of the
manufacturing sector; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Decline in exports to USA and
European countries
18. DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether our country's export to USA
and European countries is falling;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) the action taken in this regard; and
(d) the steps taken by Government to
retain the Generalized System of Preference
(GSP) granted by USA?
Establishment of Areca Board
19. DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Arecanut growers of
Karnataka have been demanding
establishment of an Areca Board;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

5
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the reaction of Government in this
regard; and
(d) the steps taken by Government to
protect the interests of Areca growers?
SEZ status to infocity near Jatni,
Orissa
20. SHRI B.J. PANDA:
MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Orissa Government has
requested the Centre for according Special
Economic Zone (SEZ) status to the
proposed second infocity near Jatni;
(b) if so, the status thereof; and
(c) the time-frame within which the
approval of the Centre would be conveyed
to the State Government, if not, already
done?
Improving growth of manufacturing
sector
21. SHRI B.J. PANDA:
MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Centre proposes to
work out fresh agenda to step up
manufacturing sector growth;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) what is the status of manufacturing
sector in Orissa and what is the action plan
of the Centre to help the State to further
develop this sector;
(d) what are the irritants and bottlenecks
that are hindering progress in the matter;
and
(e) what is the action plan of
Government to address this issue?
Market access to service sector in
European countries
22. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
has not been able to get adequate market
access to service sector in European
countries;
(b) if so, whether it is a fact that
Government has not made concrete
proposals in this regard;
(c) if so, in what way does Government
propose to use the WTO negotiations to
get entries for our software export sector
in Europe and Japan; and
(d) the details of any strategy that has
been evolved thus far?
Expansion of promotional work of
MPEDA
23. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) how many officers  the Marine
Products Export Development Authority
(MPEDA) have in the country and abroad;
(b) whether MPEDA has any proposal
to expand its promotional network;
(c) what specific plans the MPEDA
have to explore and win new markets for
marine products from Andhra Pradesh;
and
(d) the details of such plans to boost
marine exports from the country?

6
Investment by Norwegian firms in
SEZs
24. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has invited
specific Norwegian  firms to invest in
various SEZs in India;
(b) what are the details of this offer to
firms from Norway;
(c) whether land has been promised to
firms from Norway;
(d) what gains will accrue to the country
from Norwegian firms;
(e) the details thereof; and
(f) the reaction from Norway?
Trade pact with Norway
25. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether any bilateral trade pact has
been signed with Norway recently during
the visit of the Norwegian Trade and
Industry Minister;
(b) if so, the details of such a Trade
Pact;
(c) what benefits are expected to accrue
to India from this trade pact;
(d) whether a wider consultation will
be held before Government implements
such trade pacts; and
(e) the steps proposed to protect Indian
trade interests?
Reduction of soldiers on J&K border
26. SHRI HARISH RAWAT:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the number of soldiers on
Jammu-Kashmir border has been reduced;
(b) whether cross-border terrorist
activities by Pakistan have declined; and
(c) whether Pakistan has also reduced
the number of soldiers on its borders and
has accepted the Indian Line of Control
and the details thereof?
Purchase of Israeli missile system
†27. SHRI PYARELAL
KHANDELWAL: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are
contemplating any plan to buy Israeli
missile system to rid Indian Army of
apprehensions of air strike;
(b) if so, details thereof; and
(c) present status of indigenous missile
production?
Development of infrastructure for
textiles sector
